memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: '"The Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you."' - Num 6:25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The blessing continues with a picture of overwhelming warmth: "The Lord make his face shine on you." Imagine a face lighting up with delight at the sight of someone loved. That is the image here. God's shining face means His pleasure, His warmth, His glad attention turned toward you.

Many people carry a fearful picture of God — as if His face were always frowning, disapproving, hard to please. But this blessing reveals the true heart of God toward His people. His face shines. He looks upon His own with warmth and grace, not with a cold or angry stare.

And notice the word "gracious." God's shining face is a gracious face. His favour toward us is not something we earn by being good enough; it flows from His grace. He is kind to us not because we deserve it, but because that is who He is.

This finds its brightest fulfilment in Jesus. Paul writes that God's glory shines "in the face of Christ" (2 Cor 4:6). When we look at Jesus, we see the shining, gracious face of God turned fully toward us. In Him, we see how God truly feels about His people — full of grace and truth.

If you have imagined God as distant or disapproving, let this blessing correct that picture. His face shines upon you in Christ. You are looked upon with love and grace today.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What picture of God's face do you carry in your heart?
- How does it change things to know God looks on you with warmth?
- How do you see God's gracious face in Jesus?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your face shines upon me with grace, not frowns. Help me to see Your true heart toward me in the face of Jesus. Amen.
